comments.body:
At present, the following modules (excluding fcrepo-webapp) have runtime dependencies on fcrepo-kernel-modeshape:

fcrepo-audit
fcrepo-http-commons
fcrepo-http-api
fcrepo-module-auth-xacml

I would also note that almost all of the modules (including fcrepo-kernel-api) depend on org.modeshape/modeshape-jcr-api (e.g. org.modeshape.jcr.api.JcrConstants).

Furthermore, fcrepo-auth-common and fcrepo-connector-file also depend directly on org.modeshape/modeshape-jcr (as opposed to org.modeshape/modeshape-jcr-api)

Other than (perhaps?) fcrepo-connector-file, I would think that the only dependencies (transitive or direct) on anything modeshape-related should be confined to the fcrepo-kernel-modeshape module.
fcrepo-connector-file is a bit different. It really doesn't make any sense without MODE.

I agree that any dependency to MODE should be factored through fcrepo-kernel-modeshape. We should investigate why those constants are in use. They should probably be laundered through Fedora's model classes.

This change will certainly affect downstream applications in -exts and/or -labs

After this is reviewed, the ticket should be reopened. The changes in this PR imply changes with several downstream (-exts, -labs) projects.

This is a good incremental update, but we should either change the title of this ticket or solve the entire issue. Below are the projects that need to have a dependency on fcrepo-kernel-modeshape removed:

  1. fcrepo4
  • fcrepo-http-api
  • fcrepo-webapp
  • fcrepo-http-commons
  • fcrepo-connector-file - ok
  1. Other projects

  • fcrepo-module-auth-webac
  • fcrepo-audit
  • fcrepo4-oaiprovider
I say keep the ticket as-is and make steps inside it. (Subtix.)
